description.text:
A QLoRA fine-tune of **Qwen3-8B** for medical question answering, released as the evaluated artifact for a study of **training-corpus overlap in medical language model benchmarks**.

> **Read this first.** An earlier version of this card reported an average of 76.4% across seven medical benchmarks and a +24.2-point gain over the parent checkpoint. **Those figures are superseded.** They were produced by log-likelihood scoring on benchmarks subsequently found to overlap the fine-tuning corpus by up to 100%. Under overlap-audited evaluation the measured gain over the parent checkpoint is **+5.2 percentage points** on a held-out benchmark subset. The numbers below are the corrected ones, and the accompanying paper is largely *about* why the earlier figures were misleading.

serving.notes: generation_config.json only sets eos_token_id, pad_token_id, and _from_model_config. The temperature, top_p, and max_new_tokens above are the card's evaluation protocol, which also sets max_model_len 12000 and greedy decoding. Training max sequence length is 6,144. Epochs are stated as 3 main + 1 answer-format stabilisation, not as one number. config.json dtype is float16, unsloth_fixed true, unsloth_version 2026.2.1. The card says weights are stored in float16. No adapter_config.json is in the repository. The Zenodo page did not load. A web-search index still shows an older README (Pentabrid, cc-by-nc-nd-4.0, higher benchmark scores); the raw main README fetched today matches the cached corrected card, which says those earlier figures are superseded. The organisation profile still states older gains.

evaluation_reported.text: Under overlap-audited evaluation the measured gain over the parent checkpoint is +5.2 percentage points on a held-out benchmark subset. Exact-stem-unflagged MedXpertQA (n = 1,838): parent 15.6% [14.0–17.3], this model 20.8% [19.0–22.8], gain +5.2. Full set (n = 2,450): parent 17.5%, this model 24.5%, gain +7.0.

discrepancies: QLoRA, the three named exam sets, and parent Qwen/Qwen3-8B match the inventory. The card also says the 97,041-example corpus includes an OCR textbook component and is not released. The word SFT is on the ablation arm (Plain SFT); this checkpoint is labeled Full recipe.
